task: 8.4 Flag workshop references affected by the hardening edits
purpose: Phase 2 synchronization input. WHERE a Phase 1 SQL-hardening edit altered a code region referenced by a workshop Line_Anchor or Answer_Key, this artifact emits a flag for each affected workshop reference (Req 9.6). It is a Phase 2 input: 'Line_Anchor' flags are consumed by CC9 line re-anchoring (task 13); 'Answer_Key' flags are consumed by CC10 answer-key sync (task 14). The flag is the deliverable here; the actual re-anchoring / answer-key regeneration happens in Phase 2 against the verified post-refresh repository.
method: Cross-checked each CC7-hardened source region (tasks 8.1 rds.py, 8.2 product.py) against (a) the Req 11.3 Line_Anchor set and the workshop content tree, and (b) the four Answer_Key locations of Req 14 (workshop markdown, static/solution/*, assets/solution.zip, repo Solution/*).
